def: The repeating unit of a Transformer: an attention sublayer and an MLP sublayer, each with a normalisation and a residual connection.
The running (B, T, C) state of a Transformer, to which every sublayer adds its output and from which every sublayer reads.
The position-wise feed-forward network in a block: expand each token vector to about four times its width, apply a nonlinearity, project back.
Applied to each token position separately with the same weights, so it cannot move information between positions.
A smooth activation that multiplies each input by the probability that a standard normal variable is below it.
A layer that multiplies two parallel linear projections of the input element by element, one of them passed through a nonlinearity that acts as a gate.
A gated MLP using the SiLU nonlinearity as its gate, with hidden width about 8C/3 to match the parameters of a standard MLP.
A Transformer built only from causally masked self-attention blocks, which predicts each token from the ones before it.
The final linear layer that maps each position's C-vector to one logit per vocabulary entry.
Reusing the token embedding matrix as the output head, which saves V times C parameters.
An unnormalised score for one vocabulary entry, which a softmax turns into a probability.
A block variant that computes attention and the MLP from the same normalised input and adds both outputs to the stream.
